verdict.rationale: Microsoft claims broad compatibility with existing devices and accessories (most Windows 10 hardware works on Windows 11), and the PC Health Check app suggests installs are checked against hardware requirements. On lock-in, community reports say setup hides the local-account option and steers users to a Microsoft Account; you can only bypass this by installing offline or entering a fake phone number, and one user sees Microsoft removing the option altogether. missing for 10: documented support for installing on arbitrary or custom-built hardware, a first-party supported path to use the OS without a Microsoft Account, and independent hands-on confirmation of hardware freedom.
